question: ‘Beri-Beri’ is caused by the deficiency of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**thiamine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thiamine:**

 
 
• Thiamine, also known as Vitamin B1, is essential for energy metabolism and nerve function.
 
• A deficiency of thiamine leads to Beri-Beri.
 
• Beri-Beri can manifest in various forms, including wet Beri-Beri (affecting the cardiovascular system) and dry Beri-Beri (affecting the nervous system).
 
• Symptoms include muscle weakness, fatigue, and neurological problems.
 
• Thiamine is found in foods like whole grains, legumes, and pork.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Riboflavin:**

 
 
• Riboflavin, or Vitamin B2, is important for cell growth and energy production.
 
• A deficiency of riboflavin can cause conditions like cheilosis (cracked lips) and glossitis (inflamed tongue).
 
• It is vital for healthy skin and eyes.
 
• It is found in dairy products, eggs, and leafy green vegetables.
 
• It also helps with the metabolism of fats.
 
 
 
• **Cyanocobalamin:**
 
 
• Cyanocobalamin, or Vitamin B12, is crucial for red blood cell formation and nerve function.
 
• A deficiency of Vitamin B12 can lead to anemia and neurological problems.
 
• It is primarily found in animal products like meat, fish, and dairy.
 
• It is essential for DNA synthesis.
 
• Vegetarians and vegans may need to supplement their diet with B12.
 
 
 
• **Niacin:**
 
 
• Niacin, or Vitamin B3, is involved in energy metabolism and DNA repair.
 
• A deficiency of niacin causes Pellagra, which is characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia.
 
• It is important for healthy skin and the nervous system.
 
• Niacin is found in foods like meat, poultry, and grains.
 
• It can also be produced by the body from the amino acid tryptophan
